headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Learnt lesson last time: July protesters return with masks, goggles.
Counter Congress’ campaign against SIR, Telangana BJP chief tells party cadre.
Over 5,000 detained in Delhi amid anti-CEC protest.
Anti-CEC protest LIVE updates: 'We still don't know where they are'.
Will respond to critics at appropriate time, says Satish Jarkiholi.
bullets_ur: Pichli baar sabaq seekh liya: July ke muzahireen masks aur goggles pehan kar wapas aa gaye.
SIR ke khilaf Congress ki mohim ka jawab dein, Telangana BJP chief ki karkunan ko hidayat.
CEC mukhalif ehtijaj ke doran Delhi mein 5,000 se zyada afraad ko hirasat mein le liya gaya.
CEC mukhalif ehtijaj LIVE updates: 'Hamein abhi tak maloom nahi ke woh kahan hain'.
Munasib waqt par tanqeed karne walon ko jawab doonga, Satish Jarkiholi ne kaha.
